gloss: beginning of the year, New Year

definitions.gloss: beginning of the year, New Year
definitions.explanation: The first days of the new calendar year, typically referring to early January.

examples.japanese: {年始|ねんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to make a New Year greeting visit.

examples.japanese: {年始|ねんし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to visit my relatives' homes at the start of the new year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ことにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I always spend the year-end and New Year holidays at my parents' house.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the compound ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧ (year-end and New Year period). On its own, {年始|ねんし} often refers specifically to the custom of visiting people to exchange New Year greetings ({年始回|ねんしまわ}り).

CULTURAL NOTE:
{年始|ねんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ (New Year greetings) is an important social custom in Japan. People visit relatives, neighbors, and business associates in early January. In business contexts, companies may send {年始|ねんし} greeting cards or make courtesy calls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年始|ねんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: New Year greeting
- {年始回|ねんしまわ}り: rounds of New Year visits
- ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧: year-end and New Year period
- {年始|ねんし}⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧: New Year holidays
